# Checklane

Checklane grades websites 0-100 on AI-shopper readiness: whether AI shopping
agents can find, read, and buy from a site.

## What we offer

- Free audit: enter any domain at https://getchecklane.com/ and get a 0-100
  score in about a minute. No account, no login.
- Full report ($9): every check explained, every fix ranked by impact, with
  step-by-step implementation guidance your own team can follow.

## What the audit checks

- AI checkout handshake: Google's Universal Commerce Protocol profile
  (/.well-known/ucp) and Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP) checkout signals
- schema.org Product/Offer markup: names, prices, photos, stock
- XML sitemap and product feeds
- robots.txt rules for AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot,
  Google-Extended, and others)
- Page readability: real text, llms.txt, Open Graph tags
